# Generated by the Niobium FHE Application Design AI Assistant (FHEanna).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(era_quiz CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

# One package brings the whole stack: Niobium's instrumented OpenFHE + libnbfhetch.
find_package(NiobiumFhetch REQUIRED)

foreach(prog keygen encrypt server decrypt)
  add_executable(era_${prog} ${prog}.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(era_${prog} PRIVATE Niobium::niobium_fhetch)
endforeach()
